spec.hypothesis: Within the H100 marketplace-ask series, origins with relative_q80 >= 0.13 are the volatile stretches, and always-narrow beats medium on that series (0.0560 vs 0.0616). The cutoff sits between the rejected >=0.15 subset (15 decisions) and the full marketplace_ask class (24). It drops only the calmest origins, so it selects a different set of decisions. It keeps the neocloud H100_80GB origins (q80 below 0.003) out, which blocked the broader cutoffs.
